With \(A=(0,0), B=(20,0), D=(0,23), C=(20,23)\):

- \(M\), midpoint of \(CD\), is \((10,23)\).
- Reflection of \(M\) across \(A\) is \(X=(-10,-23)\).

Area of \(\triangle XBD\):
\[
\frac12 \left| \det(B-X, D-X) \right|
= \frac12 \left| \det\begin{pmatrix}30 & 10\\ 23 & 46\end{pmatrix} \right|
= \frac12 |30\cdot 46 - 23\cdot 10|
= \frac12 \cdot 1150 = 575.
\]

\[
\boxed{575}
\]
